methods.agent: raw public chat plus public operational numerics; no canonical interpretation
methods.rule_text: the same raw public chat and public operational numerics, interpreted by the frozen parser
methods.numerical: causal sensor telemetry only when the event becomes observable; no chat text
methods.oracle: canonical structured interpretation at the public report time; labelled upper-bound reference

valid_contrasts.agent_vs_rule_text: isolates contextual LLM interpretation of the same public information
valid_contrasts.agent_vs_numerical: estimates the value of advance unstructured information, not interpreter accuracy
valid_contrasts.agent_vs_oracle: measures headroom relative to perfect advance interpretation; oracle is not deployable

closed_loop_outcomes: tokens, API cost, latency, and compute

common_upstream_roles.trigger: canonical structured notice, fixed across all evaluator arms
common_upstream_roles.pricing: deterministic price-zone pricing, fixed across all evaluator arms

methods.agent_evaluator_raw_text: LLM interprets raw public operator text; deterministic code scores the schedule
methods.rule_text_evaluator: frozen parser interprets the same raw public operator text; the same deterministic code scores the schedule
methods.structured_evaluator_oracle: receives the canonical structured priority; labelled oracle upper bound
methods.evaluator_removal_control: uses hard solver and feasibility checks but ignores the qualitative priority

comparison_order: projected full-day cost or revenue among compliant schedules
regret relative to the structured oracle
tokens, API cost, latency, and compute
controlled_evaluator_ablation.full_day_accounting: realized settled prefix plus candidate remaining horizon
controlled_evaluator_ablation.rerun_mechanism: an interpreted missed priority becomes a high-penalty soft optimizer requirement on the single rerun; slack is logged if the target is unattainable

reporting_constraints: Do not call the no-evaluator schedule better merely because it is cheaper when it violates the operator request.
Do not present the structured oracle as an equally informed deployable baseline.
Do not pool case-mode cells before reporting their individual results.
Report absolute currency differences when a full-day reference is zero or negative.
